I corrected the file (registry assignment only — verified in an offline network namespace to return the staged file paths), but had no remaining test allowance to rerun the reference.
The corrected setup is left in its final state and should be re-run in a later stage: uv environment, staging of the two input h5 files with md5 verification, and the corrected analysis.py.
